title: Import immutable Interface Package with Schema-driven CA-SL IntelliSense and read-only explorer
body:
## Goal

Import **one complete immutable CA-SL Interface Package** into Skill Studio from either a local ZIP or an exact pinned GitHub Release asset, and make its exported Schemas/Tools/Capabilities **read-only, navigable, syntax-highlighted and useful for authoring IntelliSense**. The import must use the released Compiler's Interface Package/Dependency Lock contract, never a Studio-only package format.

## Verified baseline (2026-11-25)

- **Publisher prerequisite for the read-only SBI Interface Package is satisfied.** [ca-client-tools v1.1.0](https://github.com/odango-chan/ca-client-tools/releases/tag/v1.1.0) publishes the standalone `ca-client-tools_interface_1.1.0.zip`; [ca-client-tools#31](https://github.com/odango-chan/ca-client-tools/issues/31) is complete. It exports eleven public READ Tools in two Capabilities. It is not the OpenAMSM MAS Owner v1alpha4 contract package and does not export the MAS mutation callables.
- **Compiler prerequisite is satisfied.** [ca-skill-compiler v2.1.0](https://github.com/odango-chan/ca-skill-compiler/releases/tag/v2.1.0) is published. Its Development Build API accepts formal `connectionagent.io/interface-package/v1alpha1` snapshots and emits `VALIDATED / LINKED / BUILT / NOT_ADMITTED` when its exact non-empty lock closure is valid.
- **Editor-first Interface Package import is implemented and merged.** [PR #267](https://github.com/odango-chan/ca-skill-studio-demo/pull/267) merged as `11b124679746644f79bd82e296e253b7c463c179` after exact-head CI PASS. It adds browser-local ZIP selection, bounded ZIP/manifest/hash validation, immutable snapshot persistence, Package Explorer exports, native read-only source documents, JSON/YAML language IDs and Schema Preview, local/sibling Schema `$ref` navigation, and the first Schema-driven CA-SL completions.
- **The default Example package preload is implemented.** [PR #270](https://github.com/odango-chan/ca-skill-studio-demo/pull/270) merged as `d3b1d36e6574d7d9c87473a0ee2340727140fb71`. It pins three project dependencies: `mas` (`tool-catalog`), `ca-context` (`schema-bundle`) and `ca-client` (`interface-package`). The three MAS Contracts declare roots `ca-context: urn:connectionagent:ca:host-context` and `mas: urn:openamsm:mas:tool-contracts`. The extra `ca-client` v1.1.0 package is for read-only SBI query IntelliSense; it is not a Contract root and must not be substituted for either root.
- **Project lock semantics:** `skillc.lock/v0.1` is the Studio-owned persistent import/provenance lock. It stores exact immutable snapshots and re-verifies bytes. It is not the Compiler's `interface-dependency-lock/v1alpha1`; #269 derives that Compiler lock for each BuildRequest from the exact Contract roots and selected package closure. Do not migrate or replace the Studio lock.
- **Compiler linking is still a separate, open integration.** The current `mas` and `ca-context` roots are locked as `tool-catalog` and `schema-bundle`, not formal Interface Packages. The v2.1.0 Development Build request path accepts only formal Interface Package snapshots. Those roots must be published/pinned in the frozen Interface Package format before the current MAS Example can be LINKED/BUILT. Studio must not synthesize a package manifest or mutate imported bytes. See [Issue #269](https://github.com/odango-chan/ca-skill-studio-demo/issues/269).
- **Known acquisition limitation:** CI Chromium's direct GitHub Release fetch is blocked by CORS/network and fails closed; browser-local device ZIP selection is the supported path. Production Pages-origin CORS remains `NOT_CHECKED`.
- Existing local `schemas/*.schema.yaml` still have the source-backed Schema Inspector/Preview and diagnostics ([PR #262](https://github.com/odango-chan/ca-skill-studio-demo/pull/262), merged). This is separate from imported immutable Interface Package source.

PR #267 exact-head acceptance passed PR Verify, IDE Host, Theia Browser Host, Theia Browser-Only, Pages build/Chromium and the real published v1.1.0 ZIP verification. The browser upload probe used a synthetic release-shaped ZIP; the actual published ZIP was independently verified in release CI. This is not a production deployment, Compiler qualification, Owner authorization or Runtime Admission.

## YAML-first Schema authoring vs immutable package wire format

**Confirmed in `ca-client-tools v1.1.0`:** Provider-authored Schema sources are `contracts/provider-bindings/v2/schemas/*.schema.yaml` (JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 expressed as YAML). The canonical release generator `internal/interfacepkg/generate.go` reads these YAML sources and emits `schemas/*.schema.json` in the frozen Interface Package. Do **not** require Provider authors to migrate source files to JSON or treat `*.schema.json` as a hand-maintained source of truth.

- Studio must provide first-class **native YAML highlighting and Schema Preview** for authored `*.schema.yaml` as well as JSON Schema `*.schema.json`. Both represent the same JSON Schema semantics, but their byte formats and provenance differ.
- The *formal Interface Package ZIP* importer must respect the frozen `connectionagent.io/interface-package/v1alpha1` file manifest. Import exact published `*.schema.json` bytes; **do not rewrite, convert, reserialize or replace** manifest entries during import. A ZIP containing only source `*.schema.yaml` is not automatically a conforming published Interface Package.
- If local raw `*.schema.yaml` sources are offered separately, treat them as **authoring sources**, not as an already signed/locked Interface Package. Any conversion to JSON for publication must occur at the canonical publisher/compiler boundary, preserving `$id`, `$ref`, required fields, dialect and deterministic identity, with explicit errors on unsupported constructs.
- Acceptance must cover both a real Provider `*.schema.yaml` authoring document and the matching released `*.schema.json` dependency document, verifying syntax colors, source navigation, Preview, accurate provenance and immutable locked bytes.

## Delivery A — canonical immutable acquisition and Compiler linking (P0)

- [x] Provide `Import Interface Package ZIP` (local) and `GitHub Release` (explicit owner/repo, tag, exact asset filename, SHA-256) in **Add Dependency**. Do not default to latest/main or silently fall back when offline. Browser-only Theia must not need a backend ZIP extractor. Implementation merged in #267: browser-local device File API upload and exact pinned GitHub Release selection (CORS failure remains fail-closed; local ZIP is the supported browser path).
- [x] Accept root `package.json` with frozen `connectionagent.io/interface-package/v1alpha1`. Reject traversal/absolute paths, symlinks, duplicate and case-colliding names, malformed/compressed bombs, over-limit entries, missing/extra/unlisted manifest files, wrong digests, unsupported dialects and malformed export closure. Safe ZIP/manifest validation, path/case/symlink/CRC/size checks and exact listed-file digest closure are implemented and tested in #267.
- [x] Importer validates the frozen package API version, language target, packageId/version/publisher, file digests, export paths and duplicate export identities. Compiler-owned linking and transitive closure validation remain in #269; Studio does not reimplement those semantics.
- [x] Preserve exact imported bytes in immutable, read-only snapshots and persist project declarations plus the Studio `skillc.lock/v0.1` provenance lock. This lock is deliberately distinct from the Compiler `interface-dependency-lock/v1alpha1`, which #269 derives per BuildRequest.
- [x] Preserve and expose manifest-declared exports generically, including Schema-centric packages; do not require a 5GC-specific Tool name. The importer does not replace Compiler validation of allowed export kinds, transitive package dependencies or link closure; those remain #269.
- [ ] Feed the **same locked bytes** to Compiler Check/Build. Positive: released v1.1.0 package and one synthetic Skill referencing a public READ callable; negative: corrupted hash, missing/ambiguous Schema, broken `$ref`, wrong dependency or lock. Report Compiler link/build separate from Runtime Admission. (Compiler v2.1.0 Build/Verify integration is owned by #269).

## Delivery B — native source experience for imported exports (P1, part of this Issue)

- [x] In Package Explorer, show `Dependencies → <alias> → ToolCatalog / Capabilities / Schemas / Evidence` based only on exact locked manifest exports. Show package ID, version, source/tag/asset, digest and trust/readiness separately. Tree nodes navigate to source documents; no external fetch on click. Implemented in #267 with read-only ToolCatalog / Capability / Schema / Evidence / Manifest export nodes and provenance.
- [x] Open every imported source as an **immutable virtual document** in the existing single left Source editor group, retaining the one right-side Preview/Inspector. No third editor group and no editable copy of imported files. Implemented as immutable virtual documents in the single left Source group with the shared right Preview.
- [x] Ensure native VS Code/Theia **syntax highlighting** works for `*.schema.json`, `*.schema.yaml`, `package.json`, `tool-catalog.yaml`, `capabilities.json` and evidence YAML/JSON. Assign correct language IDs to virtual-document URIs (the custom `skill-studio-dependency:` scheme need not inherit language recognition by suffix). Reuse installed native JSON/YAML grammars and themes; don't write a new regex highlighter. Native JSON/YAML language IDs and Schema Preview are implemented; visible token-color assertions for every listed file type remain in acceptance below.
- [x] Add bounded Schema-aware completion from exact locked exports for Tool `arguments`, local `context.request.*`, and dominating Producer output paths. No guessed IDs or remote Schema fetches.
- [ ] Add Schema-aware Hover, cross-package reference resolution and authored-CA-SL completion for all declared dependency roots; keep the current conservative unsupported/composed-schema behavior.
- [x] Local/sibling `$ref` Go to Definition inside an imported immutable Interface Package is implemented.
- [ ] Add authored Skill Contract / Procedure references and dependency-qualified cross-package Schema navigation to the exact locked export and source range; no remote resolution.
- [x] Where the existing `schema-editor.mjs` Preview can be reused, render a read-only Schema tree on the right with field type, required, enum, description and `$ref` relationship; Preview must never claim a field is authorized or a runtime payload is validated. Read-only Schema Preview is implemented for imported JSON/YAML Schema documents.
- [ ] Reuse #211's shared diagnostics and native Problems/markers, with owning source range, for a broken import, stale lock, missing Schema export, ambiguous ID or unsupported Schema dialect. `NOT_CHECKED/BLOCKED` must not be shown as PASS; Compiler absence must not erase deterministic local diagnostics.

## Acceptance / gates

- [ ] Real released `ca-client-tools_interface_1.1.0.zip` imported via local upload and pinned GitHub Release produces identical locked manifest and files, source/provenance visible, read-only.
- [ ] Theia Browser-Only + IDE Host + real Chromium: open the imported JSON Schema, YAML ToolCatalog, Capability JSON; **visible native syntax colors**, correct virtual-document language ID, left Source/right Preview placement, no third column, and no edits to dependency bytes.
- [ ] Ctrl+Click/Definition from an authored CA-SL reference lands on the imported declaration's exact file and line, including multiple similarly named Schema files; unresolved/ambiguous/missing dependency does not jump to a guessed target.
- [ ] Completion and hover are based on the current exact lock and disappear/refresh when the generation changes; no duplicate or stale Problems. Check imported/local Schema Syntax independently of Compiler.
- [ ] Compiler v2.1.0 Check/Build synthetic positive, bad `$ref` negative, and lock-digest corruption negative. Report `LINKED/BUILT` without implying Host Runtime authorization or real-5GC qualification.
- [x] PR #267 exact-head PR Verify, IDE Host, Theia Browser Host, Browser-Only, Pages build/Chromium and published ZIP verification all PASS. Pages PR build is not a production deployment.

## Explicit boundaries

- Do not create a Studio-owned ToolCatalog, Schema dialect, package manager, legacy compatibility parser, mutable dependency checkout, arbitrary remote Schema resolver, or another editor/Language Server.
- A trusted snapshot is **not** Owner/Capability authorization; a successful Compiler Build is **not** Runtime Admission.
- Schema and language-service UI are generic; do not hardcode 5GC/MAS.
- Follow-up Host cutover remains [ca-agent-demo#241](https://github.com/odango-chan/ca-agent-demo/issues/241). Shared diagnostic ownership is [#211](https://github.com/odango-chan/ca-skill-studio-demo/issues/211).

## Schema-driven SKILL IntelliSense (explicit user priority, 2026-11-24)

**Primary goal is completion, not syntax highlighting.** As soon as a verified Interface Package is imported and locked, the current CA-SL Language Service should use its exact exported ToolCatalog and JSON Schema documents to offer deterministic authoring assistance.

- [x] First LSP slice in [Draft PR #267](https://github.com/odango-chan/ca-skill-studio-demo/pull/267): derive `operation.tool` / `observation.tool` input Schema from exact `inputSchema` / `queryContextSchema` `$ref` and manifest exports; complete missing `arguments:` keys, required-first, suppress duplicate keys, show types/descriptions, offer declared `enum`/`const` values.
- [x] Use the same Package generation and locked snapshot as existing LSP; do not invent Tool identities or use remote Schema lookups. A successful authoring hint does not imply Owner grant or Compiler linking.
- [x] In merged PR #267, support nested **`context.request.*`** from the exact local Contract `requestSchema` (YAML-first), and **`node.operation.output.*` / `node.observation.output.*`** from locked published output Schemas only when the producer stage dominates the consumer across DAG routes and Wait timeout branches. Cycles, unknown Schema applicators and ambiguous Tools yield no speculative suggestions. No guessed runtime values.
- [ ] Extend to `context.*` outside `context.request` only where an exact, trusted Context Schema and exposure rules are available; add Producer-output visibility beyond the conservative DAG subset where provable.
- [ ] Add Schema-aware `Hover`, cross-package `Go to Definition`, and native Problems for unresolved/ambiguous references, all sharing the existing LSP/index architecture.
- [ ] Build a real Theia/Chromium UI acceptance: import the released v1.1.0 ZIP, select its qualified Tool, type in `arguments:`, see field/enum completions, verify insertion and no stale suggestions after explicit relock.
- [ ] Bind the same immutable Interface Package snapshots to official Compiler v2.1.0 Check/Build separately; Runtime/Owner authorization remains distinct.

Authoring source stays YAML (`*.schema.yaml`), released Interface Package stays immutable JSON (`*.schema.json`). Do not turn these into competing manually maintained Schemas.


## Delivery split (2026-11-24)

- **Editor-first usable slice:** [PR #267](https://github.com/odango-chan/ca-skill-studio-demo/pull/267) is MERGED (2026-11-24; `11b124679746644f79bd82e296e253b7c463c179`) and [PR #270](https://github.com/odango-chan/ca-skill-studio-demo/pull/270) is MERGED (default Example package preload). The Studio lock is `skillc.lock/v0.1` and remains an import/provenance lock. Editor status remains `AUTH_NOT_CHECKED` / Compiler `NOT_LINKED`; neither PR claims Runtime/Owner admission.
- **Compiler cutover:** [Issue #269](https://github.com/odango-chan/ca-skill-studio-demo/issues/269) owns the Studio-side resolver-to-Compiler v2.1.0 BuildRequest adapter (`resolvedDependencies` is builder input), exact snapshot/lock closure, Development Build + VerifyDevelopment, diagnostics and Package Audit / AI candidate gates. The frozen Development BuildRequest does **not** accept `trustedBuildContext`, Owner attestations, Deployment Grants, live Evidence or Provider bindings; Host Admission and Runtime requirements remain separately owned. Owner/Capability static contracts must be published as formal Interface Package exports, but `publisher` is declarative identity, not authorization. Editor hints must never manufacture trust bindings.
- **Still in this issue:** native real import click-through on a production-equivalent Pages origin, imported callable/schema cross-definition/Hover and broader authoritative `context.*` completion. Keep #261 open until those are addressed.
